mission_02: You have implemented Prototypical Networks, an elegant and effective approach to few-shot classification. By representing each class as a prototype (mean embedding) and classifying based on distance, you created a method that requires no parameter updates at test time — just a forward pass through the embedding function and distance computation. The episodic training paradigm, where each episode simulates the few-shot test scenario, is crucial for learning representations that generalize to new classes. Prototypical networks have been extended with various distance metrics (Mahalanobis, cosine), attention mechanisms, and transductive settings. They remain one of the most widely used few-shot learning methods due to their simplicity, efficiency, and strong performance.
